# 1 Clement Chapter 22 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)

**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 22 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_022_page_001.jpg

---

## Council Notes

Chapter 22 closes the first major section of the letter (chs. 1-22) with a string of Psalm 34 and Psalm 32 citations. The framing of v.1 is theologically rich: "faith in Christ confirms all these things" — the preceding arguments about humility and order are confirmed by the Christian faith itself. Then Clement makes a striking claim: Christ himself speaks through Psalm 34, calling the Corinthians.

This "prosopological" reading — identifying the speaker of a Psalm as Christ — is common in early Christian exegesis (cf. Hebrews 2:12-13, where Christ is said to speak Ps 22:22). Clement applies it here to Psalm 34, making the call "come, children" a direct summons from Christ to the divided Corinthians.

The chapter ends with two contrasting notes (vv.8-9): the righteous face troubles but are delivered; the sinner faces troubles but those who hope in the Lord receive mercy. This is a gracious conclusion — leaving open the possibility of mercy for those in Corinth who repent.

---

## Chapter 22

**22:1** Now faith in Christ confirms all these things; for he himself through the Holy Spirit calls us thus: "Come, children, hear me; I will teach you the fear of the Lord."

**22:2** "Who is the man who desires life, who loves to see good days?

**22:3** Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking guile.

**22:4** Turn away from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.

**22:5** The eyes of the Lord are upon the righteous, and his ears are open to their cry.

**22:6** But the face of the Lord is against those who do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth." [Ps 34:11-16 LXX]

**22:7** And again: "The righteous man cried out, and the Lord heard him and delivered him from all his troubles." [Ps 34:17 LXX]

**22:8** "Many are the troubles of the righteous, but from them all the Lord will deliver him." [Ps 34:19 LXX]

**22:9** "Many are the troubles of the sinner, but mercy shall surround him who hopes in the Lord." [Ps 32:10 LXX]

---

*SOPHIA consensus translation. Completed 2026-03-17.*
